method: Ran the 101-ID W6 count verifier against the explicit master pass list, restored tracker, plan, specification, audit summary, and latest progress note. No network or provider calls.

observations.trace: 101 distinct lesson IDs resolve in the tracker, including evaluation/eval-env exactly once. The published percentage is 70.14%; plan, spec, tracker, and audit summaries agree on 101/144 with 43 remaining; the latest progress note records 100/144 to 101/144.

limitations: This check validates recorded unique-pass bookkeeping and does not itself establish the lesson review quality; that is supported by the separate full-scope review evidence.
